question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping/collapse be accepted as a bundled dashboard plugin feature after Wave 1, and should whole-agent collapse state be transient UI state or persisted workspace preference?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new Control UI product surface layered on an unmerged dashboard architecture, so automation cannot safely choose storage, visibility, or roadmap sequencing.

options.title: Stage After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the leaf Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap Tracker
options.body: Treat this as a subtask of the broader Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap until maintainers sequence the dashboard program.

options.title: Defer Agent Grouping
options.body: Keep the initial dashboard model flat and revisit per-agent grouping only if multi-agent dashboard usage proves the need.

recommendation.title: Stage After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the leaf Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main seam and product boundary this feature extends are most strongly tied to his recent Control UI/plugin-tab work.
